title: TabDAG: Structured Evolutionary Search for Tabular Feature Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.22828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feature engineering can improve tabular prediction, but useful transformations are compositional, data-dependent, and subject to leakage constraints. We present TabDAG, a framework that combines evolutionary search with a graph representation of feature-engineering programs. Nodes implement row-wise or data-fitted transformations; edges encode dependencies among raw variables, intermediate values, and final features. The representation supports interactions, statistical encodings, clustering- and neighborhood-based features, and multi-stage compositions in a single executable program. Mutations are structured edits constrained by a parent-specific schema and checked before evaluation. In our experiments, no structurally invalid program reached evaluation, although proposals could be rejected and valid graphs could still fail at runtime. translated_title: TabDAG：面向表格特征工程的结构化进化搜索
translated_abstract: 特征工程可以提升表格数据的预测效果，但有用的转换是组合性的、依赖于数据的，并且受到数据泄露约束的限制。我们提出了 TabDAG，一个将进化搜索与特征工程程序的图表示相结合的框架。节点实现逐行转换或基于数据拟合的转换；边编码原始变量、中间值和最终特征之间的依赖关系。该表示能够在单个可执行程序中支持交互特征、统计编码、基于聚类和邻域的特征以及多阶段组合。变异是受父代特定模式（schema）约束的结构化编辑，并在评估前进行检查。在我们的实验中，没有任何结构无效的程序进入评估阶段，尽管某些提议可能被拒绝，有效的图仍可能在运行时失败。在十个回归和分类数据集以及三个表格模型家族上，进化出的特征（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: TabDAG 提出将进化搜索与特征工程程序的有向无环图表示相结合，通过受父代模式约束的结构化变异并在评估前进行有效性检查，自动组合生成包含交互、统计编码和聚类邻域特征等多阶段转换的表格特征工程程序。
en_tdlr: TabDAG combines evolutionary search with a graph representation of feature-engineering programs, using schema-constrained structured mutations validated before evaluation to automatically compose multi-stage tabular features such as interactions, statistical encodings, and clustering/neighborhood-based features.
